title: Offline adapter: CVaR-aligned training loss (A) and horizon-conditioned output residual head (B)
frozen_at: 2026-10-09, after round 11 (anchoring: no validation gain; no test) and before any round-12 trajectory (one Traffic H6 smoke training cell each for cvar0.5 and hhead excepted)
exploratory_disclosure: Exploratory; the seed-2 test period has been used seven times.
base_recipe: a0e15 (VICReg alignment off, On epochs 15, patience 3, checkpoint by validation MSE), frozen seed-2 iTransformer backbone, online parameter updates off (lr 0)

changes.cvar0.1 / cvar0.5: loss = MSE + lambda * [tau + mean(max(e_i - tau, 0)) / 0.1], e_i = per-origin observed MAE (scoring variables, mask, scale), tau = cross-batch EMA (0.9) of the batch 90% quantile, lambda in {0.1, 0.5}; offline training only (batch > 1)
changes.hhead: forecast = head(z + r) + std * MLP([z_n, 8 window offset statistics, h/H, sin(pi h/H), cos(pi h/H)]); shared across variables; last layer zero-initialised; original MSE loss

candidate_note: r5 = a0e15 adapter (round-5 control); second element = round-5 backbone-first gate (gs 0.9, mu 0)
selection: seed-2 validation r=0 (entry seed 200); robust score = max(whole GM, largest per-third GM) of the CVaR90 ratio to iTransformer over 36 tasks; argmin; ties toward r5+gate, then listed order
reporting: whole and per-third scores, adapter share, per-domain validation ratios
test_use_policy: test only if the winner is a new candidate with robust validation score <= 0.985, and only after user confirmation
